comparison.objective: Open a bottle by lowering a detented safety loop and pressing a rocker while keeping it upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential latch manipulation and bottle stabilization, not pouring, granular screening, bridge release, or bimanual screen handling.
comparison.success_condition: Credit tracks safety-loop and lid angles with upright/support and force fault gates; candidate tracks feed fraction, recovered-media mass, washer retention, loss, damage, release, and dwell.
comparison.reason: The record tests a passive detent-and-rocker mechanism, meaningfully unrelated to selective separation. No material rubric detail is missing.
